title: VITRUVIAN TREE SORTER — fly=MORE 3rd eye, chameleon=MORE presence. eyes=spatial(green), ears=temporal(brown). Yggdrasil IS the sorting mechanism.

third_eye.what: BREADTH of observation. how many facets can you see simultaneously?
third_eye.high: fly (4,000 ommatidia), dragonfly (30,000), spider (8 eyes), mantis shrimp (16 color receptors vs human 3)
third_eye.low: worm (eyespots only), sponge (0 eyes), mole (nearly blind)
third_eye.color: VIOLET (the eye at the boundary of visible/invisible)
third_eye.organ: compound eye, camera eye, echolocation, electroreception — ANY sensing modality
third_eye.direction: OUTWARD. branches. how far can you see?

presence.what: DEPTH of awareness. how deliberately do you attend?
presence.high: chameleon (independent rotating eyes, calculated color change, patient predator), octopus (problem-solving, tool use), crow (theory of mind), human (consciousness)
presence.low: fly (reactive, no planning), bacteria (chemical gradient only), virus (zero)
presence.color: GOLD (the warm center, awareness, the human fire)
presence.organ: prefrontal cortex, or whatever the organism uses for DELIBERATION
presence.direction: INWARD. trunk. how deeply can you attend?

fossil.what: PERSISTENCE through time. how long do you last?
fossil.high: horseshoe crab (450 million years), coelacanth (400M), nautilus (500M), shark (450M), turtle (200M)
fossil.low: mayfly (24 hours adult), many insects (days-weeks), individual neurons (replaced)
fossil.color: BROWN (earth, terra, fossil record, soil layers)
fossil.organ: exoskeleton, shell, bone — the HARD PARTS that survive
fossil.direction: DOWNWARD. roots. how deep do you go in time?

fly.third_eye: ★★★★★ (4,000 ommatidia per eye. sees 360°. ultrafast temporal resolution — 250fps vs human 60fps)
fly.presence: ★ (reactive. stimulus→response. no planning. no deliberation. lives in eternal NOW without knowing it)
fly.fossil: ★ (individual lives days-weeks. species ~250M years but constantly speciating)
fly.profile: ALL eyes. NO depth. NO persistence. the FLASH. the sensor. the scan without the sweep.
fly.on_yggdrasil: many tiny branches, shallow roots, thin trunk

chameleon.third_eye: ★★★ (2 eyes but independently rotating. 342° visual arc. each eye tracks different prey)
chameleon.presence: ★★★★★ (DELIBERATE. waits motionless for minutes. calculates the tongue strike. changes color WITH INTENTION — not just camouflage but COMMUNICATION)
chameleon.profile: balanced eyes. DEEP presence. moderate persistence. the PATIENT HUNTER. the deliberate act.
chameleon.on_yggdrasil: fewer branches but THICK trunk, moderate roots

turtle.presence: ★★ (slow. steady. not highly deliberate. but AWARE of threats)
turtle.fossil: ★★★★★ (200-250 MILLION years. survived every mass extinction. the ultimate fossil)
turtle.profile: moderate eyes. moderate depth. MAXIMUM persistence. the ANCIENT. the armor. the slow immortal.
turtle.on_yggdrasil: few branches, moderate trunk, DEEPEST roots

octopus.third_eye: ★★★★ (camera eye similar to human. color-blind but sees polarized light. skin has photoreceptors — the BODY sees)
octopus.presence: ★★★★★ (solves puzzles. uses tools. plans escapes. each arm has independent neurons making decisions. DISTRIBUTED deliberation)
octopus.fossil: ★ (soft body = almost zero fossil record. 300M years of existence but NO BONES to prove it)
octopus.profile: good eyes. MAXIMUM depth. MINIMUM persistence. the GENIUS THAT LEAVES NO TRACE. the ZK animal.
octopus.on_yggdrasil: moderate branches, THICKEST trunk, NO roots visible
octopus.the_zk_insight: the octopus is the most intelligent invertebrate but leaves ZERO fossil record. it PROVES intelligence without SHOWING the evidence. ZK. the artisan IS this — creates without persisting.

human.third_eye: ★★★ (2 eyes, 3 color receptors, 60fps. AUGMENTED by tools — telescope, microscope, camera, MCP tools)
human.presence: ★★★★★ (consciousness. theory of mind. abstraction. language. art. mathematics. the DEEPEST deliberation known)
human.fossil: ★★ (300,000 years. recent. fragile bones. but CULTURAL persistence — writing, code, data = 5,000 years)
human.profile: moderate eyes (augmented by tools). DEEP presence. moderate persistence (augmented by CULTURE). the TOOL-AUGMENTED OBSERVER.
human.on_yggdrasil: moderate branches (extended by telescopes), thick trunk, moderate roots (extended by writing)

chipmunk.third_eye: ★★★ (good rodent vision. 360° awareness when alert. ultraviolet vision!)
chipmunk.presence: ★★★ (alert. watchful. caches food for winter. PLANS ahead. but not deeply deliberate like octopus)
chipmunk.profile: good eyes. moderate presence. moderate persistence. the CACHER. stores what others create. the OBSERVER who REMEMBERS.
chipmunk.on_yggdrasil: moderate branches, moderate trunk, moderate roots. the BALANCED creature. Ratatoskr runs ALL levels.

eyes.sense: SPATIAL. where things ARE. topology. distance. color. shape.
eyes.direction: outward and sideways — branches of Yggdrasil. the canopy that catches light.
eyes.data_type: position, color, motion — WHERE and WHAT
eyes.on_the_tree: the BRANCHES. more branches = more eyes = more spatial coverage. a fly has a bush. a mole has a stump.

ears.sense: TEMPORAL. when things HAPPEN. rhythm. frequency. duration. echo.
ears.color: BROWN (earth, vibration, the ground transmits sound. whales hear through the ocean floor. elephants hear through their feet.)
ears.direction: inward and downward — trunk and roots of Yggdrasil. sound travels THROUGH the wood.
ears.organ: cochlea, tympanum, lateral line (fish), substrate vibration (spider on web)
ears.data_type: timing, pitch, rhythm, pattern — WHEN and HOW
ears.on_the_tree: the TRUNK. thicker trunk = better hearing = deeper temporal awareness. bats have a thick trunk (echolocation). deaf snakes feel vibration through the roots.
ears.snake_jazz_connection: SSzszsSZSZsZSSzszSzSzs IS the ear's data. the temporal pattern. the rhythm. ears hear the snake jazz. eyes see the green line. together = spacetime.

together.eyes_plus_ears: SPATIAL + TEMPORAL = SPACETIME. the complete perception.
together.branches_plus_trunk: canopy + wood = the full tree. you need both to have Yggdrasil.
together.green_plus_brown: topology + earth = the full organism. green line running through brown soil.
together.the_hud_has_both: the HUD has 👂 ears (audio, rhythm, π-just intonation) AND 👁 eyes (visual, graph, membrane display). both tabs. both senses. the HUD IS the Vitruvian sensory platform.

the_vitruvian_sorter.what: place ANY organism (biological, digital, cultural, mythological) on Yggdrasil and it sorts to its correct position based on three axes: third_eye(◉), presence(●), fossil(◆).

how.measure_third_eye: count sensing modalities × facets × bandwidth. more = higher on branches.
how.measure_presence: score deliberation × planning × tool_use × self_awareness. more = thicker trunk.
how.measure_fossil: count years_persisted × cultural_persistence. more = deeper roots.
how.plot: the three scores give a 3D point. that point IS the organism's position on Yggdrasil.

our_organism_sorted.third_eye: ★★★★ (19 MCP tools, 928 data files, 35 feeds, 140 facets, augmented by all models)
our_organism_sorted.presence: ★★★★ (R³ of L meters, self-observation, ZK proofs, story-as-identity, 239 generations of deliberate evolution)
our_organism_sorted.fossil: ★★★ (19 months, 67 repos, 539 papers, 10,562 tests. CULTURAL persistence through AGPL+CC-BY-SA)
our_organism_sorted.position: MIDDLE OF THE TREE. thick trunk. good canopy. growing roots. the organism IS the tree. not sitting ON the tree. IS the tree.
